ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all Ultimate Beneficial Owners, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic Egyptian Central Bank AML/CFT Suspicious Activity and Terrorist Financing Watchlist. Enhanced Due Diligence is required for any individual identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) under Law No. 80 of 2002, including verification of source of wealth and source of funds. A written risk assessment must be retained and refreshed every six months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Egyptian Business Portal / GAFI ONE electronic company registration system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be formulated in Arabic script and comply with Egyptian commercial naming regulations. A foreign-language transliteration in English may be entered concurrently as a secondary name. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise in the Commercial Register of Egypt, and must not violate public order, state sovereignty, religious sensitivities, or accepted commercial morality.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Religious terms (e.g., Islamic, Christian, Jewish, Mosque, Church)
Any word implying sovereign, governmental, military, or public sector sponsorship
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may submit a written administrative appeal to the GAFI Legal Dispute Settlement Committee within 30 calendar days from the date of the rejection notice. The appeal must include the original rejection letter, a copy of the commercial registration application, and legal arguments supporting the proposed name. GAFI must decide within 15 business days. If the appeal is denied, a new name application may be submitted through the GAFI ONE portal after payment of a new filing fee. In the case of ministerial-sensitive tokens, unconditional prior approval from the relevant line ministry is a prerequisite to filing any appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not acceptable as the sole registered office for an Egyptian limited liability company. A physical, real-world office address must be recorded in the Commercial Register and be available for service of process and government inspections. A licensed business services provider offering a shared physical workspace with a service agreement, physical signage, mail handling, and access to meeting rooms may be used, but the provider must be duly licensed under Egyptian law and the arrangement must be documented as a commercial lease or service agreement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for passive electronic inventory distribution; estimated annual unannounced physical inspection probability of 10% based on the company's registration as an ordinary commercial distributor with no statutory license, limited cash handling, and standard banking rails. The likelihood rises to 25% if the LLC applies for a free-zone benefits package or a special economic zone license.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended, including Law No. 4 of 2018) and Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; limited liability company provisions under Articles 1-23 and relevant Executive Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center; Commercial Registration Office under the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Contract (Memorandum and Articles of Association / 'System al-Sharika') authenticated by the Egyptian Notary Public.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Investment Law No. 72/2017. Capital is fixed by the members, fully subscribed, and paid in cash or in-kind with expert valuation where required. No escrow account is mandatory for cash contributions unless the project benefits from special investment incentive schemes.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation documents and capital subscription schedule of the Limited Liability Company are hereby ratified, and the subscribed shares are allotted to the founding members as set forth in the Articles of Association. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office in the Arab Republic of Egypt is adopted as the address stated in the Articles, and shall be the official seat for all legal, tax, and administrative purposes. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed as Sole Manager and [Name] as Financial Officer, each authorized to act singly for ordinary operations and jointly for banking matters and contracts exceeding EGP 100,000, and the bank accounts are authorized to be opened with any licensed Egyptian bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center / Commercial Registration Office online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic and English company names through the GAFI online commercial name reservation system. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain the Official Name Reservation Certificate, which is valid for 60 days. No notarization is required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney if a registered delegate files the application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited words, file a new request with alternative names within 5 business days at no additional penalty; administrative objections are resolved by the GAFI Name Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the LLC Company Contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Notary Public Authority (notary office in the governorate of the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the LLC Memorandum and Articles of Association in Arabic, including member details, capital, management rules, share transfer restrictions, and registered office address. All founders execute the contract before the Notary Public, who authenticates their signatures. Notarization is a mandatory precondition for GAFI registration.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all founding members
Lease contract or title deed for the proposed registered office
Personal identification numbers (or tax card numbers) of founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary questions the document, correct the drafting anomaly and re-execute before the same notary; material changes require a supplementary notarial deed before GAFI submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Subscription and Payment Certificate (if capital is declared)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed Egyptian bank or the National Bank of Egypt branch handling the temporary incorporation account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the company name with the draft Articles of Association and name reservation certificate. Deposit the declared issued capital or, in the case of zero statutory minimum, obtain a bank letter confirming no deposit is required. If in-kind contributions are used, obtain a certified valuation report.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening due to AML documentation gaps, supplement the source-of-funds declaration and re-submit; any change in capital requires a notarial amendment to the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center (one-stop shop)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation file to GAFI through the online portal or in-person. GAFI reviews the notarized Company Contract, registered office lease, capital certificate, and incorporation application. Upon approval, GAFI issues the Commercial Registration Certificate and notifies the Tax Authority and Social Insurance Organization.
required_dossiers: Bank capital certificate or waiver letter
Board resolution / subscribers' minutes approving incorporation
Passport copies of all members and managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query or a return for correction, respond within 15 days with revised documents; if the objection relates to legal capacity or defective notarization, obtain a corrective notarial deed and re-file without incurring a new fee for the first resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Import Code, and Social Insurance Post-Registration Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Egyptian Customs Authority, and National Social Insurance Organization (NSIO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Commercial Registration Certificate, apply at ETA for a Tax Card and VAT registration (mandatory if taxable supplies exceed the ETA threshold). Apply to Customs for an Import/Export Code if the distribution activity includes cross-border trade. Register employees and managers at NSIO for social insurance contributions and obtain the NSIO certificate.
required_dossiers: Company Contract and name reservation certificate
Formal board resolution on officer appointments
Employee identification documents for NSIO registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any mismatched company name, address, or officer details with GAFI and obtain an updated registration extract before re-filing with ETA or Customs; NSIO objections are cured by submitting the missing payroll declaration and residence permits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) — not applicable for distribution-only companies; regulatory clearance passes through GAFI Commercial Registration and, if warehousing is added, local governorate civil defense approval.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Commercial Registration Certificate (Licens al-Tijari) is the sole operating authorization; no separate industrial operating license is required for passive electronic component distribution.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 3 (non-manufacturing distribution activity does not require a full Environmental Impact Assessment report; only a simple environmental registration or site conformity note may be requested for the office/warehouse).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply to pure storage and distribution of passive electronic components. If damaged or obsolete capacitors/resistors are stored, the facility must comply with waste segregation under Ministerial Decree No. 176/2019 and transfer any electronic waste to an EEAA-licensed recycler; no uncontrolled discharge or open burning of electronic waste is permitted.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Civil Defense Authority is required for the warehouse or storage area, including fire extinguishers, clear exit paths, and compliant electrical wiring. Occupational safety clearance is issued after inspection by the Ministry of Manpower, covering first-aid kits, ergonomic material handling, and a workplace risk assessment adapted to low-voltage electronic inventory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Main Portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; e-Invoicing and e-Receipts Clearance Portal: https://invoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must obtain a unified Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) from the Egyptian Tax Authority by filing the company's incorporation contract, commercial registry extract, tax card application, legal entity identification data, and notarized power of attorney. Submission is made through the ETA Taxpayer Services Centers or the unified electronic tax portal. The TIN serves simultaneously for corporate income tax, VAT, withholding tax, and stamp duty obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – Egypt is a unitary jurisdiction with no sub-state income tax distinction. An Egyptian LLC is a separate juridical person subject to corporate income tax at the headline rate of 22.5% on worldwide taxable income under Law No. 91 of 2005. No pass-through or transparent classification is available for LLCs. Foreign shareholders are additionally subject to withholding tax on dividends and certain payments under domestic law and applicable tax treaties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election exists under Egyptian tax law. An Egyptian LLC is peremptorily classified as fully taxable. A group of wholly-owned Egyptian subsidiaries may elect to file consolidated tax returns if it satisfies the ETA's minimum ownership and holding-period conditions. Investment projects licensed under the Investment Law may elect a tax stabilization regime to fix their applicable tax rate and rules for a guaranteed period. No other entity classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Law No. 67 of 2016 and its Executive Regulations (replacing prior General Sales Tax regime)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable turnover of goods and services is the mandatory registration threshold; importers are required to register regardless of threshold, and voluntary registration is permitted for persons carrying on taxable economic activity even below this threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt has a mandatory electronic invoicing (e-invoicing) regime administered by the ETA. Registered businesses must submit B2B invoices in real time to the ETA e-invoicing API in the prescribed JSON/XML format for fiscal clearance before issuance to the buyer. Only cleared invoices receive the ETA-generated QR code, unique invoice code, and validation stamp. Unclearable or rejected invoices are treated as non-compliant and, in practice, disqualify input VAT deduction. Egypt also operates a phased e-receipts mandate for B2C retail transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods, including passive electronic components such as multilayer ceramic capacitors and resistors, is zero-rated for VAT purposes when the seller is a registered VAT person, the sale is correctly coded as an export in the ETA e-invoicing system, the goods physically depart from Egypt, and the exporter duly receives and repatriates the foreign currency proceeds. Directly related services (international freight, handling, insurable risk abroad) performed to bring exported goods to foreign markets also qualify for zero-rating where separately evidenced.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ETA zero-rating export invoice (e-invoice with export code)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may retrospectively claw back zero-rated export VAT at the standard 14% rate plus late-payment interest of 1.5% per month or a fraction thereof, up to a maximum of 100% of the assessed VAT, if the exporter fails to produce the full export documentation bundle, misses the 180-day foreign-currency repatriation deadline, or is found to have issued a zero-rated invoice without genuine physical export. Administrative fines may reach EGP 2,000,000 per violation under Law No. 67 of 2016. Fraudulent export zero-rating with an intent to obtain a tax refund is a criminal offense punishable by imprisonment and fines of up to EGP 5,000,000. The VAT audit look-back period is five years, extended to six years in cases of fraudulent intent.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) is the sole monetary, FX, and exchange-control authority under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law). CBE-licensed commercial banks execute all FX operations and register every inflow/outflow in the CBE electronic exchange-control platform; the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) separately licenses non-bank fintech and payment institutions under the Payments Law No. 18 of 2019. No foreign currency transaction may bypass the local banking system: the Egyptian LLC must route all cross-border settlements through its CBE-licensed account banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the 6 March 2024 exchange-rate unification, the EGP is a market-determined floating currency with current-account convertibility: import/trade payments, service fees, freight, and commissions execute at any licensed bank without CBE pre-approval, subject to electronic import-form (Form A) registration and underlying customs/shipping documents. Capital-account operations remain administered: inward FDI equity is freely registerable and convertible, but profit/dividend remittances require proof of the original CBE-registered inward FDI, audited accounts evidencing distributable profits, and a tax-clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority, creating a practical 1 to 4 week clearing cycle. The 2022-2023 FX liquidity backlog has largely been absorbed after the float, so a trade-active distributor faces low conversion risk; outbound capital repatriation, offshore borrowings, and portfolio transfers still require prior CBE approval, making EGP a hybrid regime: free current account, controlled capital account.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds for goods (HS 8532/8533 capacitors and resistors) must be repatriated and posted to an account at an Egyptian CBE-licensed bank within 90 days from the export customs certificate date, and reported on the CBE electronic exchange-control platform. The mandatory sale/conversion ratio was revoked after the 6 March 2024 float: the LLC may retain 100% of export USD/EUR balances in segregated accounts, apply them directly to offshore supplier invoices, freight, insurance, and commissions, and carry balances forward indefinitely without forced conversion into EGP. Any non-repatriated balance must be accompanied by documented justification (carrier delay, LC dispute, arbitration); failure triggers suspension of the exporter's import and LC facilities, blacklisting for export financing, and fines and penalties under Law No. 194 of 2020.

Capital Escrow Account (for initial paid-in capital deposit certificate), convertible to Operational Account
Operational Account (USD-denominated import settlement and LC annex)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and audited financial statements annexed as tax basis evidence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 April of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fixed late-filing penalty of EGP 1,000 to EGP 5,000, plus monthly delay interest on unpaid tax at statutory rate; prolonged non-filing triggers enforced collection and company file suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements and auditor's report deposited with the company's statutory file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within two months after approval by the annual general meeting; AGM must be held within six months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine under Egypt's Companies Law; consecutive omissions can lead to removal of the commercial registration record

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial registration renewal and annual certificate fee payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal every five years from the date of initial registration; annual maintenance fee due at the start of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge computed monthly; registration struck off after prolonged non-renewal, invalidating the LLC's legal capacity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO register annual confirmation and notification of any beneficial ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI and the Financial Information Unit (FIU) as applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any ownership change; annual confirmation submitted with the AGM documentation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties under the Anti-Money Laundering Law and decapitalization of the entity for persistent non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all LLCs with paid-up capital exceeding EGP 250,000, for all joint-stock companies, and for any LLC voluntarily appointing an auditor; thresholds may be lowered by ministerial decree
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which are substantially aligned with IFRS; full IFRS is permitted for consolidated or internationally listed entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a beneficial ownership register at the registered office, record any direct or indirect ownership above the statutory threshold, and update the GAFI file within 30 days of a change; annual confirmation is submitted with the financial statements and AGM minutes

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No open-ended tax holiday. Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) projects may access a 50% CIT reduction for an initial 5-year period (extendable) under Law 83/2002. Investment Law 72/2017 allows a one-time 50% deduction of investment costs for Zone A projects and 30% for Zone B projects. Dividend distributions remain separately taxable at 10%. Distribution of passive electronic components does not qualify for sector-specific production incentives absent local manufacturing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 19 (Corporate Income Tax Return) for Egyptian joint-stock companies and LLCs; filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-portal (www.eta.gov.eg); assessed turnover must reconcile with the mandatory e-invoice/e-receipt system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four calendar months after the close of the fiscal year; calendar-year taxpayers must file by 30 April. Quarterly advance CIT instalments are payable during the year based on the prior year's liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal entity name, tax card number, commercial register number, fiscal year-end, responsible ETA tax office (ma'mouriya).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies with an Egyptian permanent establishment (PE) must register the PE as the taxable unit and present a foreign head-office address and registration certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total invoiced sales of MLCCs, resistors and passive components, net of returns and discounts, reconciled to e-invoice data and SWIFT/credit-line receipts.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must report Egypt-sourced distribution turnover only; related-party sales must be priced at arm's length and disclosed in the transfer pricing schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Opening inventory plus purchases less closing inventory; import duties, freight and handling included in inventory cost.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany purchase invoices must be supported by TP documentation; absent that, the ETA may apply CUP or Cost Plus adjustments to reconstruct gross margin.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, rent, depreciation, logistics, marketing, bank charges and interest; non-documented or excessive items must be added back.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recharges from the foreign parent must satisfy the real and documented services test, be subject to the 20% domestic WHT on service fees where applicable, and exclude hidden profit attribution to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 — Net Operating Loss / NOL Deduction
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before loss utilisation less NOL carryforward from prior years (maximum 7 years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses of the Egyptian PE are deductible; foreign head-office losses may not be offset against Egyptian PE profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final assessable profit to which the 22.5% CIT rate is applied after all adjustments and NOL utilisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the PE cannot substantiate accounts, the ETA may apply deemed-profit ratios for distribution activities; otherwise actual books govern.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT computed at 22.5% less advance instalments, third-party WHT certificates, and SCZone/Investment Law tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No unilateral foreign tax credit is granted to the Egyptian PE; only treaty-based credit relief applies. Non-resident shareholders must attach a residence-state TRC to any reduced-WHT claim on distributions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Attachments — TP Disclosure and Financial Statements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Audited financial statements, ETA-issued transfer pricing disclosure form, Local File / Master File if thresholds are exceeded, and e-invoice ledger summary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The TP disclosure must identify all related parties, cross-border goods flows, and the selected arm's-length method; non-submission is an automatic audit red flag.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed fine of EGP 500–5,000 under Article 75 of Law 91/2005, plus a 2% monthly delay tax on the unpaid tax capped at 40% of the total assessed tax. Repeated non-filing may trigger criminal prosecution, seizure of bank accounts and travel bans against directors.
